scope: Qualification and implementation of native repair, original-call reconciliation and restart-safe measurement persistence. Production deployment, assessment reset and scientific criterion changes are excluded.
acceptance: A repair enters the native builder with retained source and checkpoint, changes experiment.py, executes incident-bound tests and freezes the exact candidate before fresh scientific reviews.

A terminal native stream whose finish acknowledgement was lost can be reconciled from its exact admitted request, original stream and durable completion receipt without replaying inference or rewriting the original call.
Incomplete streams, missing identities, changed bytes, active work and genuinely unknown calls remain fenced. Reconciliation records are append-only, service-only and idempotent.
An interrupted bounded measurement ingestion recovers the original retained response and persists one run and one set of observations without another execution.

Actual Linux TCP/netem observations retain the complete five-condition loss grid, three 30-second invocations per condition, units, invalid observations, source/configuration hashes and raw artifacts.
Restart and storage-failure controls retain original commitments, deadline and criteria and demonstrate no duplicate launch or inference. Local fixtures never become production paper evidence.

qualification.platform: Record actual architecture; linux/amd64 qualification must be explicit, emulation is labelled.
qualification.provider: Existing authorized subscription only, no paid fallback and no retry of an uncertain call.

evidence: Retain original failed and passed logs, exact source/protocol hashes, actual available usage, raw measurements and all unverified boundaries. AI implementer review is neither independent nor held-out validation.
